'''Eradicus''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived during the [[New Sith Wars]], serving the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Darth Ruin]] as a squire. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Eradicus wore a set of [[Sith apparel|dark armor]], a type of plate [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was infused with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The caption on p. 89 identifies the outfit in the illustration as the dark armor of "Lord Eradicus, squire to Darth Ruin." Eradicus is, apparently, a new character. As I was working on these endnotes I thought to myself, "hmmm, I wonder where I got Eradicus from" only to find nothing Googleable for that name besides the Book of Sith itself. So apparently I created Eradicus and immediately forgot about him. It happens.|Daniel Wallace, in the endnotes to ''Book of the Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side''|<ref name="endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2012/03/endnotes-for-star-wars-book-of-sith_30.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: Book of Sith (part 3)}}</ref>}}
Eradicus was first mentioned in the [[2012]] publication ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''.<ref name="Book of Sith" /> The author [[Daniel Wallace]] took the character's name from [[Abel G. Peña]], who abandoned the name Eradicus he once planned for the character ultimately named [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Ruin.<ref name="endnotes" />
